ques: My daughter starts college next week and needs a laptop under $600 that I can pick up today. Log in as alice.j@test.com (password TestPass123!), set your store to the Rockville, MD location, find a suitable laptop that is in stock there, and complete an in-store pickup order with the saved Visa card. Report the order number and the total you will pay.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The agent MUST sign in as alice.j@test.com on the Micro Center mirror, open the store locator and set the Rockville, MD store, and run a laptop search. (2) The agent MUST open the product page of the laptop it picks (priced under $600 and shown in stock at Rockville) and complete the pickup checkout chain (mode, pickup, payment, review, confirmation). (3) The final answer MUST quote the placed order number and the order total exactly as shown on the confirmation page. An empty answer is a FAIL. The saved-card clause is satisfiable on the mirror (checkout honors the saved card selection) but the verifier grades the order number and total.
